concept.material: turned walnut wood and brushed brass
concept.internal_detail: fine brass coil springs and tiny wooden rocker arms
concept.button: a small brass push-pin at the narrower end
concept.shell_mechanic: The wooden ellipsoid halves hinge outward from the center like a split seed pod
concept.emerging_parts: A hinged brass beak, jointed wooden wing plates, and spring-loaded tail struts
concept.signature_move: its jointed brass beak pivots rapidly downward on its neck hinge to tap three sharp clicks against the palm, and its tail struts brace firmly
concept.turkish: Ağaçkakan (ağaç gövdelerine tırmanan, sert gagalı kuş) — pürüzsüz elips, tornalanmış ceviz ağacı ve fırçalanmış pirinç
